_README: infra-audit manifest. Arms ONE box (or subproject) -- copy to the box as audit.config.json and fill box_id, signing.allowed_signers, allowlist, denylist, bounds. With NO manifest the agent REFUSES to run; it never guesses the target, the bounds, or the destructive scope. See ~/.claude/skills/infra-audit/SKILL.md.

_DOC.box_class: operator | client. 'client' forces stricter defaults and is surfaced in the digest. Both boxes are per-action-gated regardless.
_DOC.signing.allowed_signers: Path ON THIS BOX to an ssh allowed_signers file holding ONLY the operator PUBLIC key. The private key stays off-box (hardware token, FIDO sk- key). Verified with: ssh-keygen -Y verify. The agent UID must NOT be able to write this file (root-owned, chattr +i recommended).
_DOC.denylist: NEVER deletable. Two layers: (1) globs match the canonicalized ABSOLUTE real path (so use '*/secrets/*', NOT 'secrets/*' which can never match an absolute path) plus the basename, and any nlink>1 hardlinked target is refused; (2) for (dev,inode) IDENTITY protection against hardlink/bind-mount aliases, ALSO list high-value objects as ABSOLUTE LITERAL paths (e.g. /etc/infra-audit/allowed_signers, /var/lib/app/prod.db) -- only literal existing paths populate the identity set; globs do not.
_DOC.allowlist: The ONLY trees the agent may PROPOSE destructive actions against.
_DOC.clock: plausible_epoch_bounds, reused from swarm-verify. Any epoch outside [floor,ceil] or greater than now+max_skew is SUSPECT (sensor/clock bug), never an ALERT.
_DOC.caps: Sanity ceiling on a single action's blast radius, even though every destructive action is individually signed.
_DOC.digest.discord_webhook_env: NAME of the env var holding the webhook URL. NEVER put the secret URL here (L010 / no hardcoded secrets).
